supply-chain-posture-declared.$reason: This repository's bun project lives in `packages/js/`, not at the root. Bun reads bunfig.toml from the directory the install runs in and never walks up, so `packages/js/bunfig.toml` is the file that actually governs `bun install` here - a root bunfig.toml would be inert and declaring one would make this check green without making the install any safer. The check resolves a single `bunfigPath` against the repo root and defaults it to the root file, so this points it at the real declaration. The cooldown itself is not weakened: `packages/js/bunfig.toml` is measured exactly as a root one would be.
